items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: Another person that was here and working as a single was Harold Brown. ... he's always worked as a single.

ctx.x: He still entertains. He's not living right in town, but he's a good guy too, so maybe it's time to contact him, because he's seen a lot of things, because he's always -- he has always been on top of things and worked in the very finest spots, you know, available.

Another person that was here and working as a single was Harold Brown. Now, Harold Brown, he has worked in some very fine spots in Los Angeles, as a single. He's never -- I have never known him to work with anyone, but he's always worked as a single.
